title: Tebra Billing and Insurance Verification
description:
Full-Time Filipino Virtual Medical Assistant  

Medical Billing and Insurance Verification | Mental Health Clinic | Alaska Time



**Please do not apply without Tebra/Billing Experience!!!!



About the Position



We are a growing mental health clinic in Alaska that also provides medical services. We have previously worked with Filipino virtual assistants and understand the value of a skilled, reliable, and dedicated remote team member.



We are seeking an experienced Filipino Virtual Medical Assistant to join our clinic in a full-time, long-term position. This role will focus primarily on medical billing, insurance verification, patient account management, collections, and front-desk support.



Because this position involves direct communication with patients and requires knowledge of specialized insurance processes, applicants must have genuine, hands-on experience in a medical or mental health office. Experience with Tebra is especially important, and experience with VA and TriWest is required.



Position Details



•  Position: Full-Time Virtual Medical Assistant  

•  Location: 100% remote; applicants must be Filipino nationals currently living in the Philippines  

•  Schedule: Full-time according to Alaska Time  

•  Employment: Long-term position  

•  Exclusivity: This must be your only full-time job during your scheduled working hours  

•  Time monitoring: Work hours and activity will be monitored using Hubstaff  

•  Start date: Immediate availability is preferred  



Primary Responsibilities



Patient Communication



•  Answer phone calls from patients regarding billing, insurance, and account questions

•  Respond to patient messages professionally and promptly

•  Explain copays, deductibles, coinsurance, balances, and payment requirements

•  Communicate with patients in a friendly, respectful, confident, and assertive manner

•  Handle sensitive conversations professionally, especially when discussing outstanding balances

•  Escalate complex issues appropriately when necessary



Insurance Verification



•  Verify patient eligibility and insurance benefits

•  Confirm copays, deductibles, coinsurance, out-of-pocket amounts, and patient responsibility

•  Verify coverage and requirements for Medicare, VA, and TriWest

•  Use Availity and other payer portals as needed

•  Document benefit information accurately

•  Identify inactive coverage, missing information, authorization requirements, and other potential billing issues

•  Communicate verification results clearly to the clinic and patients



Billing and Account Management



•  Process medical billing and collections

•  Post and apply insurance and patient payments accurately

•  Review patient accounts and investigate account discrepancies

•  Correct billing and payment-posting errors

•  Follow up on unpaid or denied claims

•  Research previous billing errors and make appropriate corrections

•  Review outstanding balances and assist with account reconciliation

•  Contact patients regarding copays and past-due balances

•  Maintain accurate documentation of billing and insurance activity



Administrative and Front-Desk Support



•  Provide general front-desk and administrative support

•  Assist with patient registration and account updates

•  Help manage patient messages and administrative requests

•  Assist with the Weave phone and texting platform, if needed

•  Follow clinic procedures and protect patient privacy

•  Support the daily administrative needs of the mental health and medical practice



Required Qualifications and Experience



Applicants must meet all of the following requirements:



•  Filipino national currently living in the Philippines

•  Previous experience working in a medical or mental health office

•  Hands-on experience with medical billing and insurance verification

•  Strong, practical experience using Tebra

•  Experience with Practice Fusion

•  Direct experience working with VA and TriWest is required

•  Experience with Medicare and Availity

•  Experience with payment posting, applying payments, collections, and correcting billing errors

•  Excellent spoken and written English

•  Clear, professional American-English communication that patients can easily understand

•  Confident, friendly, and assertive communication style

•  Strong attention to detail and accuracy

•  Ability to work independently and follow established procedures

•  Professional, dependable, and committed to a long-term position

•  Availability to work the required schedule according to Alaska Time



Required Software Experience



Tebra



Tebra is the primary system used for this position. Applicants must have genuine, hands-on experience using Tebra for medical billing or related workflows.



Experience may include:



•  Insurance eligibility and benefits verification

•  Patient account review

•  Charge entry

•  Claim submission

•  Claim-status follow-up

•  Payment posting

•  Applying payments to patient accounts

•  Patient billing

•  Collections

•  Denial follow-up

•  Correcting billing errors

•  Account reconciliation



Applicants should be able to explain the specific Tebra functions they have performed and how they used the system in their previous role.



Practice Fusion



Applicants must also have experience using Practice Fusion. Tebra experience may be more extensive, but applicants should be comfortable navigating Practice Fusion and explaining how they used it for patient records, account information, documentation, or related administrative workflows.



VA and TriWest



Hands-on experience with VA and TriWest is required. Applicants must understand how to verify coverage, confirm patient benefits and responsibility, review authorization or referral requirements when applicable, and document verification results accurately.



Experience with Medicare and Availity is also required.



Work Environment and Equipment



You must have:



•  A quiet, private workspace

•  No background conversations, children, pets, television, or other distractions during work hours

•  A reliable high-speed internet connection

•  Backup internet and preferably backup power

•  A working computer suitable for medical billing and communication platforms

•  A dual-monitor workstation



You must be willing to show your workstation on camera during the hiring process.



Important Experience Requirement



Please apply only if you have actual, hands-on experience with Tebra, Practice Fusion, VA, and TriWest. General familiarity, online training, or experience using only another electronic medical record or billing system will not be sufficient.



We have previously encountered applicants who overstated their experience. To ensure we select the right person for this important role, qualified applicants may be asked to:



•  Demonstrate their knowledge of Tebra

•  Explain their previous billing and insurance workflows

•  Describe how they verify VA and TriWest benefits

•  Explain how they post payments and correct billing errors

•  Complete a short practical skills assessment

•  Participate in a video interview



Please be honest and specific when describing your experience. We are looking for someone who can perform these responsibilities accurately and confidently with minimal training.



What We Offer



•  Stable, full-time hours according to Alaska Time

•  Weekly, on-time payment

•  Competitive monthly compensation

•  Supportive and professional American management

•  A respectful and collaborative remote-work environment

•  Long-term career opportunity with a growing clinic

•  The opportunity to become an important member of our healthcare team



How to Apply



Please submit all three of the following items:



1. An updated resume  

2. A short video, approximately 30 seconds long, introducing yourself so we can evaluate your spoken English and communication style  

3. A clear photo of your current workstation showing both monitors  



Applications missing any of these items may not be considered.



Please also include the following information in your application:



•  Total years of medical billing experience

•  Total years of experience using Tebra

•  Total years of experience using Practice Fusion

•  Specific Tebra billing functions you have performed

•  Specific experience with VA and TriWest

•  Experience with Medicare and Availity

•  Your availability according to Alaska Time

•  Your preferred monthly salary

•  Your current internet speed

•  Your backup internet and power arrangements

•  Your earliest possible start date

•  Confirmation that this will be your only full-time job during scheduled work hours



Screening Questions



1. Are you a Filipino national currently living in the Philippines?

2. How many years of hands-on experience do you have with Tebra?

3. Which Tebra billing functions have you personally performed?

4. How many years of experience do you have with Practice Fusion?

5. Which platform have you used more extensively: Tebra or Practice Fusion?

6. Describe your hands-on experience verifying VA benefits.

7. Describe your hands-on experience working with TriWest.

8. Have you worked with Medicare and Availity? Please provide specific examples.

9. Describe your process for verifying a patient’s insurance benefits.

10. How do you determine a patient’s copay, deductible, coinsurance, and remaining responsibility?

11. Explain how you would post and apply an insurance payment in Tebra.

12. What would you do if a payment were posted to the wrong patient or claim?

13. Describe a billing error you identified and corrected.

14. How would you explain an unexpected patient balance to an upset patient?

15. Are you comfortable collecting copays and outstanding balances in a professional but assertive manner?

16. Are you available to work full-time according to Alaska Time?

17. Will this be your only full-time job during your scheduled working hours?

18. Do you have a quiet, private workspace with no background noise or interruptions?

19. Do you have a dual-monitor workstation?

20. What are your internet speed and backup power or internet arrangements?

21. Are you comfortable using Hubstaff to track work hours and activity?



We look forward to meeting a qualified, reliable, and experienced Filipino Virtual Medical Assistant who is ready to make a long-term commitment to our clinic.

Solid grasp of technical analysis / market structure

Discipline over conviction — you follow the risk rules even when you're sure you're right

title: Final Inspections Scheduler
description:
Job Summary



We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Final Inspection Scheduler to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating, scheduling, and tracking final inspections for completed projects [hvac, construction, permitting, residential installations]. You will serve as the primary liaison between field inspectors, local municipal authorities, project managers, and customers to ensure all final inspections are completed accurately, safely, and on schedule.



Key Responsibilities



Scheduling & Coordination:

Schedule final inspection appointments with local authorities (AHJs - Authorities Having Jurisdiction), internal/third-party inspectors, and homeowners or site managers.

Optimize daily schedules and travel routes for field inspectors to maximize efficiency and minimize transit time.

Confirm scheduled appointments with customers and provide pre-inspection preparation instructions or requirements.

Permit & Documentation Management:

Review project files to ensure all required documentation, permits, as-built plans, and sign-offs are complete prior to scheduling final inspection.

Communication & Problem Solving:

Serve as the main point of contact for field inspectors to resolve real-time scheduling conflicts or access issues.

Coordinate with project managers and repair/service teams if an inspection fails or requires corrections to ensure swift re-inspection scheduling.

Tracking & Reporting:

Maintain up-to-date status tracking for all pending, scheduled, passed, and failed inspections within [Airtable,Salesforce, Zoho, Monday.com].

Monitor open permits and track inspection turnaround times to identify bottlenecks or process improvements.

Provide daily/weekly scheduling summaries and completion metrics to management.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience:

1–3 years of experience in scheduling, dispatching, administrative support, or field operations (experience in construction, solar, roofing, electrical, or permitting highly preferred).

Familiarity with local building departments, municipal permitting processes, or Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) is a strong plus.



Technical Skills:

Proficiency with CRM systems and scheduling/dispatch software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Monday.com, Google Workspace, MS Office).

Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn new software and portal systems.



Soft Skills:

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Outstanding organizational and time-management capabilities with high attention to detail.

Strong problem-solving skills and calm demeanour under tight deadlines or changing priorities.

Customer-focused attitude with a focus on delivering a smooth client experience.

Competitive salary

title: Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel
description:
Video Editor Wanted — YouTube Channel 



**Job Type:** Freelance / Ongoing, Long-Term

**Workload:** 2 videos per week (recurring)

**Turnaround:** Fast — see details below



## About the Channel

"Permanent Jewelry, Real Talk" is a growing YouTube channel for permanent jewelry business owners — covering industry trends, business strategy, tools, and honest, no-fluff advice from a founder who's built a real studio with a team. The tone is warm, honest, and direct — like a friend leveling with you, not a polished corporate brand. We're looking for a long-term editing partner to help bring that personality to life visually.



## What You'll Be Doing

You'll receive raw, unedited sit-down talking-head footage (filmed in batches) along with any supporting photos/clips, and turn it into a polished, engaging final video — twice a week, on a consistent schedule.



## Must-Haves

- **A sharp, intriguing editing style** — you know how to take a straightforward talking-head video and make it visually engaging: pacing, cuts, zooms, text call-outs, and creative transitions that keep viewers watching, not just a static edit.

- **Fast, reliable turnaround** — you can take raw footage and deliver a finished, upload-ready video within an agreed turnaround window (please state your typical turnaround time in your application).

- **Strong command of professional editing software** (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar — no template-only tools).

- **Thumbnail design skills** — you'll also be creating custom, high-CTR thumbnails for each video (bold, clear, mobile-readable at a glance).

- **Real YouTube knowledge** — you understand what keeps modern viewers watching: strong hooks in the first few seconds, pacing that holds retention, on-screen text/captions, and current best practices for what performs on the platform (not just generic editing).

- **Consistency and communication** — reliable delivery on schedule, responsive communication, and the ability to take feedback and revise quickly.



## Nice-to-Haves

- Experience editing for business/education or personal-brand YouTube channels (not just entertainment or vlogs).

- Experience adding lower-thirds, on-screen graphics, or a consistent recurring intro/outro treatment to build a cohesive channel look.

- Comfortable syncing captions/subtitles.

- Basic motion graphics or animated text/callout skills.

- Experience repurposing long-form content into short-form clips (a plus, not required initially).



## What We'll Provide

- Raw footage, filmed and delivered in batches on a consistent schedule.

- Brand direction: tone, colors, and style guidance so every video feels consistent.

- Clear, prompt feedback on drafts.



## To Apply, Please Include:

1. Your portfolio or samples of similar talking-head/educational YouTube edits (this matters most — please don't apply without samples).

2. Your typical turnaround time per video.

3. The software you edit in.

4. Your availability for a recurring, long-term 2x/week workload.

5. Your rate per video (edit + thumbnail).



Looking for a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig — if this sounds like your kind of project, we'd love to hear from you.

You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and take an active role in the growth of the store.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

• Research products, niches, customers, and competitors

• Analyze competitor stores, pricing, offers, and marketing strategies

• Identify potential products and opportunities worth testing

• Help create product testing and marketing strategies

• Manage and optimize
/Instagram Ads and/or Google Ads

• Test different audiences, creatives, messaging, and offers

• Monitor advertising performance and sales data

• Analyze Shopify data and identify opportunities for improvement

• Identify strong-performing products and campaigns

• Recommend ways to improve conversion rates and sales

• Help develop new ideas for growing the store

• Provide regular updates and clear recommendations



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You don’t need to be an expert in everything.



What matters most is that you have real e-commerce experience, understand how online stores work, and are willing to think, test, learn, and improve.



You may be a good fit if you have experience in:



✓ Shopify

✓ E-commerce

✓ Product research

✓ Market research

✓ Competitor research

✓
/Meta Ads

✓ Google Ads

✓ Sales analysis

✓ Conversion optimization



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Has practical experience rather than only theoretical knowledge

• Can analyze data and explain what the numbers mean

• Can research products and competitors independently

• Understands the US market or has experience working with US customers

• Is proactive and willing to suggest new ideas

• Can communicate clearly and provide regular updates

• Is organized and able to meet deadlines

• Is interested in building a long-term working relationship



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



I’m not expecting you to know everything from day one.



If you are experienced in one or more areas and believe you can contribute to the growth of a Shopify business, feel free to apply.



I’m more interested in your actual experience, problem-solving ability, and results than in having a long list of certificates.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• Flexible working arrangement

• Clear responsibilities and goals

• Direct communication with the store owner

• Opportunity for long-term work if we are a good fit

• Opportunity to take on more responsibility as the store grows



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a short application answering these questions:



1. How many years have you worked with Shopify or e-commerce?

2. What areas are you strongest in — Shopify, product research, Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, or CRO?

6. What tools do you normally use for research and advertising?

8. What is your expected hourly rate?



Please include examples of your previous work or results when possible.



I’m looking forward to meeting someone who can bring great ideas and help grow the business together.

title: Supplier & Production Coordinator
description:
Anima is a premium wellness brand. We design crystal sets, candles and incense, sold on Amazon across the US, UK, Europe and Canada. Our products are made by around 11 suppliers in China and India, and we usually have many orders in production at once. We're a small, fast-moving team that works with AI in everything we do, with high standards, looking for a long-term team member.



THE ROLE



Right now the two founders read and manage every supplier message themselves. We want you to take that over. You become the person who knows the status of every order, every sample and every open issue, keeps the factories moving, and tells us clearly what needs our attention. Decisions, negotiations and pricing stay with the founders. Your job is to make sure nothing slips and nothing surprises us, six days a week, with flexibility on when you check in but never on whether you do.



Day to day you will:



- Read and manage all supplier messages daily on WeChat, reply on routine matters, and escalate anything that needs a founder

- Keep one master status sheet of all orders, samples, payments due and shipping dates, updated every day

- Follow up with factories on timelines and confirmations; chase before deadlines, not after

- Send a short daily report in Slack: what moved, what's at risk, what needs a decision

- Collect and organise supplier documents (quotes, PIs, invoices, packing lists, photos) into our shared drive

- Use AI tools daily to summarise threads, draft follow-ups, translate, and keep reports sharp

- Coordinate handoffs with our logistics and finance teammates in Slack



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU HAVE



- 2+ years supporting suppliers, sourcing or production for an ecommerce or Amazon brand

- Fluent, natural written English (you'll write to us and to factories daily)

- Real working experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) as part of your daily workflow, not just occasionally

- Serious organisation: you keep a tracker current without being asked, and you never lose a thread

- Proactive communication: you flag problems early, in plain language

- Comfort with WeChat, Slack, Google Sheets and Drive



Strong plus: experience working with Chinese factories, and with packaging, gifting, candles or mineral products.



ENGAGEMENT



Fully remote, long-term, paid monthly.



This role is less about hours and more about being on top of it, all the time. Suppliers message at any hour, and the job is to be the reliable bridge between them and the founders. That means checking WeChat and Slack several times a day, every day, six days a week (Monday to Saturday) as a minimum. Sundays can be off, but a light check-in on Sundays is a real plus. Total time is realistically around 1-2 hours a day spread across the day, not a single block. We'll calibrate the exact hours together in the first weeks based on the real workload.



If you need fixed office hours or can't check messages on a Saturday, this isn't the right role. If you like being the person who always knows what's going on and keeps everything moving, it is.



All internal communication runs on Slack.



IMPORTANT: you must be independent. No commissions or payments from any supplier, and no existing relationship with our current suppliers. This goes in the contract.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word JADE so we know you read this. Then answer these three things, briefly and in your own words:



1. A scenario. A supplier tells you on WeChat that our order will be 10 days late because of a raw-material shortage. Write the exact reply you would send to the supplier, and the exact message you would post to the founders in Slack.

2. Your system. In 3-5 sentences, how would you track 11 suppliers and 20 open orders so nothing is missed, and where does AI fit into your setup?

3. Your background. Which brands or products have you done this for, and with factories in which regions?

title: Supplier Relations & Procurement Specialist
description:
**About TrueBridge Logistics**

TrueBridge Logistics LLC is a U.S.-based procurement, sourcing, and supply-chain company serving government and commercial customers. We work with manufacturers and distributors to source products and develop reliable supplier relationships.



We are seeking a Supplier Relations & Procurement Specialist to support our growing government-contracting operations.



**About the Role**

In this role, you will communicate with U.S. manufacturers and distributors to obtain product pricing, availability, lead times, freight information, and other information needed for supplier quotations.



You will send requests for quotation (RFQs), make outbound supplier calls, follow up on outstanding requests, review incoming quotes for completeness, and maintain accurate sourcing records.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant or data-entry position. A significant part of this role involves outbound telephone communication. You should genuinely enjoy speaking with people, building professional relationships, and following up persistently.



Management retains final supplier selection, government bid pricing, bid submission, purchasing authorization, and compliance decisions.





**What You'll Do**

- Prepare and send RFQs to manufacturers and distributors.

- Make outbound telephone calls to U.S. suppliers.

- Follow up consistently on unanswered quote requests and supplier commitments.

- Obtain pricing, availability, lead times, freight charges, and other required quote information.

- Review supplier quotes for completeness and request missing information.

- Maintain accurate records of supplier communications, quotes, follow-up dates, and next actions.

- Update sourcing opportunities in TrueBridge's procurement systems.

- Prepare complete sourcing information for management review.

- Assist with supplier and distributor account applications and documentation.

- Build and maintain professional, long-term relationships with supplier representatives.





**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate:

- Speaks and writes fluent, professional English.

- Is confident and comfortable making outbound business calls.

- Enjoys communicating with people and developing professional relationships.

- Is persistent, resourceful, and comfortable following up multiple times when necessary.

- Is organized and able to manage multiple open requests and deadlines.

- Has excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

- Can work independently while following established procedures.

- Uses good judgment and knows when an issue should be escalated.

Experience in B2B customer service, outbound calling, inside sales, procurement/purchasing, supplier or vendor relations, account management, logistics, supply-chain coordination, or a BPO/call-center environment is preferred.

Previous U.S. government-contracting or Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) experience is helpful but not required. Training on TrueBridge's processes and systems will be provided.





**Schedule & Compensation**

This is a part-time position working:

Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

 20 hours per week

 $7.00 USD per hour

Training is paid.



Applicants must be able to consistently work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule and have reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a quiet professional environment suitable for business calls.



This position is intended to be a long-term opportunity. As TrueBridge grows, there may be opportunities for additional hours, increased responsibilities, advancement, and compensation growth based on performance and business needs.





**How to Apply**

Please submit:

- Your current résumé/CV.

- A 2-3 minute voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your experience communicating with customers, suppliers, prospects, or businesses by telephone. Please also explain why you believe you would be successful in a position requiring regular outbound business calls and persistent follow-up.

- Confirmation that you are available to consistently work Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET).



Candidates selected to move forward will be invited to a virtual interview.

title: WANTED! The World's Most Relentless Remote Local SEO Specialist
description:
When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions."



WHO WE ARE



We are ChiroX. We are a small, sharp search marketing agency that does one thing: we get chiropractic practices in front of people who are in pain and searching for help right now. Google Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile, landing pages, websites. That's it. We say no to everything else.



We are US-based, headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a team spread across four countries. Small on purpose. Everybody here owns something real, nobody is a seat filler, and there is no layer of management between you and the person who runs the company (that's me, Corey).



Our clients are established practices doing seven figures a year. They are smart, busy, skeptical business owners who can tell the difference between activity and results. So can we.



Take a look: 



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We need someone to own SEO for our client practices. This is a remote (work-from-home) contract position.



Right now we have a practice in Fayetteville, Arkansas that should be dominating its local market and isn't. That's your first problem to solve. From there you'd take on more of our client sites, one at a time, as you prove out.



You will not be grinding out audits nobody reads. You will pick the two or three things that actually move a local practice up the map pack, spec them clearly, hand them to our developer, and then explain to a chiropractor in plain English why it worked.



We also care a lot about AI search. Patients are asking ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews who the best chiropractor near them is, and we want our clients to be the answer. If you have been teaching yourself AEO, you are exactly who we want to talk to.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO



Own the SEO roadmap for each client site you're assigned, starting with one.



Run a monthly cycle per site: technical check, on-page work on two priority pages, internal linking, local and Google Business Profile signal review.



Set the keyword and content targets that feed our existing blog pipeline.



Build the AEO layer: schema, entity consistency, and content structured so AI search engines cite it.



Write the SEO section of each client's monthly report in language a chiropractor understands, not language an SEO understands.



WHAT WE ACTUALLY NEED YOU TO BE GOOD AT



Local SEO for service businesses. Dentists, med spas, law firms, HVAC, physical therapy, veterinary, home services. Any of it. We do NOT require chiropractic experience and honestly we don't care if you have it.



Diagnosing why a site isn't ranking and being able to say which single fix you'd do first, and why.



Writing page copy that reads like a human wrote it for a patient.



Explaining technical things to non-technical people without condescending.



Being genuinely curious about AI search, whether or not you're an expert yet.



You do not need a degree, a certification, an agency background, or ten years of experience. We will trade all of that for someone sharp, hungry, and honest.



PAY AND GROWTH



SEO ownership starts at $250 USD per client site per month.



Each new site also includes a one-time $300 audit and 90-day roadmap fee.



You start with one site so we can both find our footing, and add sites as fast as you're comfortable.



Bonus: $150 every time a designated primary keyword breaks into the top three, organic or map pack. Twice per site per quarter.



Rate moves to $325 per site once two clients hold a top-three term for 60 days.



You get first right of refusal on every new client site we sign.



The path from here is SEO Lead, owning our whole fulfillment queue.



We pay on time, every time, and we cover the transfer fees. Payoneer, Wise, or PayPal, whichever works where you live.



WHO TENDS TO DO WELL HERE



There's never one right way to do a job, but patterns show up. The people who thrive in this role are stubborn about evidence. They'd rather tell you a hard truth than a comfortable story. They get genuinely irritated by a page that should rank and doesn't, and they don't let it go. They're organized without being rigid, and they'd rather ask a blunt question than guess.



What energizes them: a problem nobody's cracked yet, being trusted to decide, seeing a number move because of something they did.



MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH THIS



I'd rather scare you off now than disappoint you in month two.



Remote work. If you don't have a quiet space with reliable power and internet, this isn't the right role.



You will not have publish access to our sites. You spec the change, our developer implements it. If you need your hands on the code yourself, you'll hate this.



Chiropractic is a slow, boring, regulated vertical. No viral plays, no linkbait. It's health content, so every claim needs a real citation.



SEO results are slow and our clients are impatient. You will be asked to explain an eight-week lag to a frustrated business owner. More than once.



Flat rate per site means some months are lighter and some are heavier. It averages out. If that variance would stress you, say so now.



We're US Central time. You don't need to work our hours, but we need a few hours of overlap for questions.



Every offer starts with a 60-day trial so we can both be sure. If you're in a stable job, please don't quit it until you're confident in this one.



OUR VALUES



Truth. We are data-driven marketers and data is truth. If something isn't working, we tell the client before they find out. If we make a mistake, we're the first to raise it. If we don't know, we say so and then go find out. If we disagree with each other, we say that too. Strategic pushback is not just allowed here, it's the job.



Ownership. Nobody here says "that's not my job." If you see something broken, you either fix it or you flag it. We'd rather you overstep than stay quiet.



Care. Our clients are real people who put their savings into a practice and hire staff and worry about payroll. When we get it right, someone in pain finds them. That's worth taking seriously.



TO APPLY



Please send the following:



A link to your resume as a PDF, named exactly: Lastname.Firstname.SEO.pdf



A short note on your local SEO experience and why you think you'd be good at this.



One example of a local business you helped rank, what the problem was, and what you did about it. Two paragraphs is plenty.



Your answer to this: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?



Your answer to this: "Work is love made visible." - Khalil Gibran. What does that mean to you?



Send it all to: 



CLOSE



We're eager to find the right person and we'll move quickly for the right one. If anything about this role or these instructions doesn't make sense, just ask. Include your question in your application and I'll answer it.



Looking forward to reading yours.



Corey

Founder, ChiroX

title: QA & Release Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking a hands-on QA & Release Engineering Manager to raise the quality bar across our software delivery process and help build a disciplined, scalable QA function. This person will actively test software, lead QA practices and standards, expand test automation, and ensure releases are validated and deployed safely and predictably.



This is not a coordination-only management role. The ideal candidate is an experienced QA or quality engineer who can set expectations for the QA team while remaining technically hands-on with testing, automation, CI/CD, deployments, and release troubleshooting. The role combines QA leadership, quality engineering, release management, and practical DevOps responsibility.



Core Responsibilities

QA Leadership, Standards & Discipline

• Own and continuously improve the QA process across the product and engineering organization.

• Establish clear QA standards for test planning, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, evidence, retesting, and sign-off.

• Set a high and consistent quality bar for the QA team and coach team members on effective testing practices.

• Ensure QA work is systematic, reproducible, documented, and traceable rather than dependent on informal or ad-hoc testing.

• Define what must be validated for different types of changes and ensure appropriate test coverage before release.

• Review QA results and challenge incomplete testing, weak defect reproduction, or unsupported sign-off.

• Identify recurring gaps in QA execution and drive corrective process improvements.

• Help establish useful QA metrics such as escaped defects, regression failures, reopen rates, automation coverage, and recurring defect categories.

• Work constructively with Engineering and Product while maintaining independent authority to determine when quality requirements have not been met.



Hands-On Quality Assurance

• Personally perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and release testing as needed.

• Create and maintain test plans and test cases for new functionality, regressions, integrations, and critical workflows.

• Validate acceptance criteria and verify that completed engineering work behaves correctly across relevant environments and scenarios.

• Produce clear, actionable defect reports with reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity.

• Ensure defects are properly retested and regressions are covered before closure.

• Focus QA effort based on product risk, customer impact, change scope, and historical failure patterns.



QA Automation & Quality Engineering

• Own and expand meaningful automated regression coverage across the product.

• Determine which tests should be automated and which are better suited to manual or exploratory testing.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests as appropriate.

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure they run at the correct stages of software delivery.

• Establish automated quality gates that prevent progression or release when required tests fail.

• Track flaky tests, automation failures, coverage gaps, and recurring regressions and drive them to resolution.

• Work with Engineering to ensure unit and engineering-level tests remain an engineering responsibility while QA provides broader product, integration, and regression assurance.

• Continuously reduce repetitive manual QA work where reliable automation provides better coverage and faster feedback.



Release Ownership & Deployment Control

• Own or directly support the end-to-end release process from QA readiness through production deployment and validation.

• Establish and enforce clear Definition of Release Ready and Definition of Release Complete standards.

• Confirm required code reviews, tests, scans, approvals, documentation, QA sign-off, deployment steps, and rollback preparation are complete before release.

• Plan, coordinate, execute, and validate production releases across relevant application components.

• Maintain release schedules, release manifests or records, release notes, deployment evidence, and rollback procedures.

• Identify release risks and dependencies early and escalate blockers before they affect delivery.

• Have the authority and judgment to stop or delay a release when required quality or readiness criteria have not been met.

• Ensure failed or partially completed releases have clear recovery and rollback procedures.

CI/CD, DevOps & Deployment Automation

• Own and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment.

• Maintain and improve Bitbucket repositories, Git workflows, branching practices, pull-request workflows, and pipeline integrations as they relate to quality and releases.

• Automate deployments across development, QA/staging, and production environments.

• Reduce manual deployment steps and opportunities for human error while preserving appropriate controls.

• Ensure pipelines provide clear visibility into failures and prevent unsafe deployments.

• Support and troubleshoot Docker/containerized application environments and deployment workflows.

• Support and oversee deployments into AWS environments, including configuration, permissions, dependencies, logs, monitoring, and deployment health.

• Help maintain consistency across development, QA/staging, and production environments and troubleshoot environment-related failures with Engineering.



Security, Release Validation & Production Follow-Through

• Integrate and maintain automated security, dependency, vulnerability, and code-quality scanning within the delivery pipeline.

• Define how critical test, security, and code-quality findings affect release readiness.

• Define and execute post-deployment smoke tests and validation procedures.

• Verify that releases are functioning correctly before considering deployment complete.

• Monitor deployment health, errors, logs, and other production signals following releases.

• Coordinate rapid response, rollback, or remediation when a release introduces problems.

• Lead or participate in post-release reviews and ensure quality or release failures result in concrete corrective actions.

• Maintain a clear audit trail showing what was released, when, by whom, and with which validations.



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong hands-on software QA experience in a production SaaS, web application, or similarly complex software environment.

• Experience leading QA practices, setting testing standards, or serving as a senior/lead QA engineer responsible for the quality bar of a team.

• Strong understanding of test strategy, functional testing, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, defect management, and release validation.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated software tests, ideally including API, integration, regression, and/or browser-based testing.

• Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience managing or directly supporting software releases and production deployments.

• Strong experience with Git workflows, branches, pull requests, and repository management; Bitbucket experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

• Working knowledge of AWS and cloud deployment environments.

• Ability to troubleshoot failed builds, pipelines, automated tests, environment problems, and deployments.

• Understanding of rollback strategies, release risk management, and production i
 response.

• Ability to distinguish between QA responsibilities and engineering responsibilities and hold both functions to appropriate quality standards.

• Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and low tolerance for undocumented, unverified, or casually bypassed quality steps.

• Ability to coach others, enforce standards constructively, and communicate clearly when work is not ready to progress.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Nice to Have

• Previous experience as a QA Lead, QA Manager, Senior QA Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, SDET, Release Engineer, or similar hands-on quality role.

• Experience managing or mentoring a distributed QA team.

• Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines.

• Experience with Docker or containerized deployments.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and AWS deployment automation.

• Experience with automated security, vulnerability, dependency, or static-analysis scanning.

• Familiarity with PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, and web application architectures.

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools.

• Experience improving an existing QA organization where processes, automation, or release discipline needed to mature.

• Experience supporting distributed engineering and QA teams.



Ideal Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior QA practitioner who wants ownership, not someone who views QA management as primarily assigning test work or tracking tickets. They are comfortable getting directly involved in difficult testing, reproducing defects, reviewing automation, troubleshooting pipelines, and validating releases.



They can walk into an existing QA process, identify where discipline or coverage is weak, establish practical standards, coach the team to meet them, and measure whether quality is actually improving. They know when a defect indicates an isolated issue and when it points to a broader gap in testing, engineering checks, or release controls.

They also understand the software delivery process beyond QA: why a build failed, why a test should block deployment, how environments differ, how a release should be packaged and validated, and where CI/CD or deployment automation can eliminate risk and manual work.



They are comfortable saying that a release is not ready when required standards have not been met, while working constructively with Engineering, Product, and QA to resolve the issue quickly.



Success in this role means the QA team becomes more disciplined and effective, automated coverage increases where it matters, fewer defects escape into production, and releases become more predictable, auditable, and automated over time.

The Sales Development Representative is the first commercial contact for potential Outdoor Norway guests. The mission is to respond quickly, speak directly with prospective guests, understand their needs, qualify their purchase potential and create momentum toward a booking.

This is not initially an itinerary-building or closing role. Once an inquiry is properly qualified, it will be handed over to an experienced Sales Specialist who will prepare the itinerary, package or final proposal.

Qualified: Genuine purchase potential with a clear requirement or next step.

Disqualified: No longer interested, opted out, invalid or not a suitable fit.

Complete every mandatory CRM property before changing a lead’s stage.

Log calls,
s, notes, outcomes and next actions on the same working day.

Participate in product and destination training.

Percentage of in-shift inquiries contacted within five minutes.

Contact and conversation rate.

Inquiry-to-qualified-lead conversion.

Quality and accuracy of qualification.

Speed and completeness of sales handovers.

CRM completeness and same-day activity logging.

Internal feedback from Sales, Marketing and Operations.

Experience qualifying inbound digital marketing leads.

Additional languages are an advantage.

Persistent without being aggressive.

Calm and professional under pressure.

Opportunity work remotely

title: Architectural Assistant / Planning Intelligence Coordinator – UK Construction
description:
About the Role



RCB Design & Build is looking for a technically minded and organised Junior Architectural Assistant / Planning Intelligence Coordinator to support and gradually take ownership of our Planning Intelligence process.



This role combines:



architectural drawing review + construction understanding + planning application research + client communication + CRM management + AI and automation tools.



This is not a general VA or data-entry role.



The successful candidate must be comfortable reading architectural drawings and understanding residential construction projects. We will provide training on our UK Planning Intelligence process, systems, workflows and procedures.



What You Will Be Doing



You will help manage residential planning opportunities identified from UK local council planning applications.



Your responsibilities will include:



Reviewing UK residential planning applications

Reading and comparing existing and proposed architectural drawings

Reviewing floor plans, elevations, sections, roof plans and site plans

Understanding what the homeowner is proposing to build

Identifying works such as:

rear extensions

side extensions

wraparound extensions

loft conversions

dormers

internal alterations

structural changes

refurbishments

Summarising proposed works clearly

Helping determine whether a project is suitable for RCB

Checking applicant, property and planning information for accuracy

Reviewing and quality-checking AI-generated project summaries and correspondence

Preparing personalised letters and project communication

Managing daily postal campaigns through Stannp

Supporting
 outreach to homeowners, architects and consultants

Communicating with prospective clients where required

Helping qualify project enquiries

Maintaining accurate CRM records

Scheduling follow-ups

Supporting consultation and site survey arrangements

Coordinating with RCB’s estimating, design and management teams

Helping improve our Planning Intelligence workflow

Using AI and automation tools to reduce repetitive manual work

What the Process Looks Like



You will be working across a structured workflow similar to:



Planning application identified → drawings reviewed → project understood → opportunity qualified → personalised letter/email prepared → quality checked → sent through Stannp → follow-up → homeowner/architect communication → qualified project → consultation/site survey → estimating/design team



Some tasks will be automated.



Your role is to provide the human technical judgement, checking, organisation and communication needed to make sure the process remains accurate and professional.



Essential Requirements



You should have a background in one or more of the following:



Architecture

Architectural Technology

Architectural Design

Civil Engineering

Structural Engineering

Quantity Surveying

Construction

Estimating

Building Technology



You must be able to:



Read and understand architectural drawings

Compare existing and proposed plans

Understand basic residential construction

Explain technical information clearly

Communicate confidently in spoken and written English

Work accurately with detailed information

Follow processes consistently

Work independently

Learn new systems quickly

Use AI and digital tools comfortably

UK Experience



Direct UK planning experience is not required.



Training will be provided on:



UK planning applications

Local council planning portals

Planning drawings and documents

RCB project qualification

Planning Intelligence workflow

CRM procedures

Stannp mailing process

Client communication standards



We are more interested in someone who already has a good technical foundation and can learn quickly.



Technology



Experience with any of the following is useful:



AutoCAD

Revit

Bluebeam

Procore

PlanSwift

Estimating software

CRM systems

Zapier

Make

n8n

ChatGPT / AI tools

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office



Experience using automation or AI in construction, architecture or project administration is an advantage.



Client Communication



This role may involve communicating with UK homeowners, architects and construction professionals.



You therefore need to be comfortable speaking professionally in English and asking clear project-related questions.



You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be confident enough to discuss a project naturally and professionally.



Who This Role May Suit



This position may suit:



Junior Architectural Assistants

Architecture Graduates

Architectural Technicians

Junior Architectural Designers

Junior Civil Engineers

Junior Quantity Surveyors

Junior Estimators

Construction Graduates

Design Coordinators

Working Arrangement

Remote / Work From Home

Full-time preferred

Monday to Friday

UK business hours

Long-term opportunity

Training provided

Opportunity to take greater ownership as you develop

Compensation



Starting rate: £3–£4 GBP per hour



The exact starting rate will depend on:



Technical ability

English communication

Drawing-reading ability

Relevant experience

Reliability

Performance during the assessment



This is intended as a long-term role, and performance/rate reviews may be considered once the successful candidate becomes more independent and capable of managing the Planning Intelligence workflow.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with the stated starting rate.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



1. Your Updated CV



Highlight your relevant experience in:



Architecture

Construction

Engineering

Estimating

Quantity Surveying

Technical coordination

2. Portfolio / Work Samples



Please include examples such as:



Architectural drawings

Construction drawings

Drawing reviews

Quantity take-offs

Estimates

Technical documentation

Residential projects

Other relevant work



Please remove confidential client information where necessary.



3. Two-Minute Video Introduction



Please record a simple video of approximately 2 minutes.



A phone or webcam recording is perfectly fine.



Please briefly tell us:



Your name

Your professional background

Your experience reading architectural drawings

Your construction or engineering experience

Your experience communicating with clients

Your experience using software, AI or automation

Why you believe you are suitable for this role

Why We Require a Video



This position includes communication with UK homeowners and professionals.



The video allows us to assess communication ability early in the process and helps both the applicant and RCB avoid unnecessary 30–45 minute introductory interviews where the role may not be the right fit.



The video is an important part of the initial assessment.



Important Application Instruction



Please begin your application with:



RCB PLANNING A2Z



Then include:



CV

Portfolio/work samples

Two-minute video

Current employment status

Notice period / earliest start date

Confirmation that you can work UK business hours

Confirmation that you are comfortable with the £3–£4 GBP/hour starting rate

A short description of your experience reading architectural drawings



Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment based on a UK residential planning application and architectural drawings.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Support Coordinator
description:
Tagair Safety is a growing Australian business providing Electrical Test & Tagging and Commercial Range Hood Compliance Cleaning services throughout regional NSW.



We are looking for an experienced, organised and trustworthy Executive Assistant & Business Support Coordinator to join Tagair full-time.



This isn’t intended to be a short-term freelance position. We are looking for one person who wants to become a genuine part of Tagair, learn the business deeply and grow with us over the long term.



Initially, your responsibilities will include administration, bookkeeping and Xero,
 management, customer follow-ups, maintaining records and CRM information, marketing support, website updates, research and general business support.



As you learn Tagair and we develop trust, I want the position to grow. The goal is for you to increasingly take ownership of areas of the business, identify things that need attention without always being asked, help improve our systems and eventually become someone I can genuinely rely upon to keep things moving.



The person we are looking for:



Skills are important, particularly good written and spoken English, administration experience and familiarity with bookkeeping/Xero. However, I’m equally interested in your character and attitude.



I’m looking for someone who is honest, dependable, caring, organised, proactive, willing to learn and comfortable taking responsibility. You should be able to communicate openly, admit when you don’t know something, ask questions when necessary and eventually be confident enough to tell me when you think there’s a better way of doing something.



Experience with Xero, Google Workspace, Squarespace, Squareup, Bigin CRM systems, Wix, Canva, social media/marketing or similar business software would be valuable, but I don’t expect one person to be an expert at everything.



Hours & Pay



This is a full-time 40-hour-per-week position, Monday to Friday.



Working hours are 8:00 am–4:00 pm NSW, Australia local time. Your working hours will therefore move with NSW daylight-saving time.



The rate is $10 per hour / A$400 per week (AUS$).



Your eight-hour paid day includes two paid 30-minute breaks at fixed agreed times. Outside those breaks, we will need you to be available and working during the agreed hours unless you advise us of anything else that comes up..



We will not need you to work any overtime and in fact insist you do not work out of these hours.



Important – Dedicated Position



This position is exclusive to Tagair. We looking for someone who wants one stable, full-time position rather than managing several clients simultaneously and that is eager to work directly with the CEO.



During your agreed working hours, you will work solely for Tagair. You must not perform work for other businesses or clients during those hours.



All Tagair work must also be completed personally by you. Work must never be subcontracted, outsourced or passed to friends, family members or other virtual assistants. We do however encourage the use of Ai applications if its going to help productivity. Tagair accounts, passwords, documents and customer information must never be shared with another person.



In return, we want to provide a stable, respectful and enjoyable working environment where you’re treated as a valued member of the Tagair team, treated with respect, compassion and professionalism. We believe that the people that work with us are to be treated like they the most important aspect of the business because the truth is, they are.



If you’re looking for somewhere you can settle in, build trust, take on increasing responsibility and grow alongside a small Australian business, we genuinely like to hear from you.



When applying, please tell us a little about yourself, not just your qualifications. Tell me about your previous experience, the type of work you enjoy, what you’re particularly good at, and why a long-term role with one Australian business appeals to you.

title: B2B Sales Closer – Corporate Stress & Health Program
description:
Location: Remote, U.S.-based

Hours: U.S. business hours

Employment Type: Contract



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced B2B Sales Closer to own the full sales cycle for a corporate Stress & Health/EAP program designed to help organizations improve employee wellbeing while addressing the business costs associated with workplace stress.



This is a hands-on closing role for a proven sales professional who is comfortable speaking with business owners, HR leaders, benefits teams, and enterprise decision-makers. You will manage opportunities from initial discovery through product demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and close.



What You'll Do:

Own the full B2B sales cycle from discovery through closing.

Conduct consultative discovery calls to understand an organization's workforce, challenges, and employee wellbeing priorities.

Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to the prospect's needs.

Develop and present pricing proposals and navigate negotiations.

Build the business case around both employee wellbeing and measurable business impact, including reduced absenteeism, disengagement, and "quiet quitting."

Manage fast-moving SMB opportunities as well as longer, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.

Build relationships with CEOs, HR leaders, benefits professionals, and other key stakeholders.

Maintain accurate pipeline activity, follow-ups, and deal progression.

Represent the client professionally as an extension of their internal sales organization.

About the Product



The program uses a tiered, per-employee pricing model, beginning at approximately $95 per employee, with volume discounts available. The offering also includes Stress Coach Course credentials, typically provided at a ratio of approximately one credential per 15–20 employees.



The sales process includes two primary deal profiles:



SMB: 10–100 employees, typically with a CEO or owner as the primary decision-maker. Shorter sales cycles and faster closes.

Enterprise: 10,000+ employees, involving multiple stakeholders and longer, committee-driven decision processes.

What We're Looking For

Proven experience closing B2B sales.

Strong consultative and discovery-based selling skills.

Experience selling to business owners, HR, benefits, or executive-level decision-makers.

Ability to communicate both emotional/value-driven and financial/business cases.

Comfortable managing both transactional and complex enterprise sales cycles.

Excellent presentation, negotiation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills.

Self-directed and comfortable working remotely.

Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Why This Opportunity



This is an opportunity for an experienced closer to represent a compelling corporate wellbeing solution without the constraints of a traditional full-time sales position. You'll become an extension of the client's team, leveraging your existing sales expertise to generate meaningful business results while helping organizations address one of today's most significant workplace challenges: employee stress and wellbeing.
